text:
maria: We need to provision a small burst GPU nodepool in eu-central1 for non-latency-critical batch jobs + personalization offline runs. Quota is tight in the project, so plan is preemptible-first with a tiny reserved H100 tail for canaries. Asking for input on sizing, taints, and autoscaler knobs.
aj: +1 on preemptible for burst. Suggest mixing A10G preemptible for bulk and 1-2 h100 reserved for smoke tests. Cost ballpark: A10G preemptible << h100 reserved, so use A10G for throughput.
devon: FYI we currently have 6 GPUs free in eu-central1 (project quota). I opened cloud quota ticket Q-4321 yesterday, ETA ~48h. Until quota bump, nodepool max has to be <=6.
samir: For workload isolation, add a taint like `workload=burst:NoSchedule` and require pods to have toleration. Keeps real-time inference off those nodes.
lucy: Autoscaler config thoughts: minNodes=0, maxNodes=6 (until quota bump), `--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m`, `--scale-down-delay-after-add=15m`, and enable `balance-similar-node-groups`. Avoids thrash for short batch spikes.
aj: Also watch node provisioning time — A10G preemptible can take longer if AZ capacity fluctuates. Set `max-empty-bulk-delete` low? (not sure) and allow `--expander=random` during rollout.
infra-bot: deploy-check: new nodepool template passes lint, net policy check flagged: egress IPs for new worker subnets not pinned. (See link: https://infra.internal/egress/requests/987)
maria: Good catch on egress. We need static NAT for these nodes when jobs call downstream APIs (rate limits). Can networking pin an egress IP for the subnet or we should route via nat-gateway?
devon: Routing via shared NAT gateway looks easiest short-term. I'll coordinate with netops. But note that NAT capacity also has quota.
samir: Pod spec snippet for batch jobs (add toleration + nodeSelector):
```
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 1
nodeSelector:
  workload: burst
tolerations:
  - key: "workload"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "burst"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
```
lucy: Example eksctl/gke pool spec (we'll adapt to our provisioning tool):
```
nodePool:
  name: burst-a10g-preempt
  machineType: a10g-standard-16
  preemptible: true
  minNodes: 0
  maxNodes: 6
  taints:
    - key: workload
      value: burst
      effect: NO_SCHEDULE
```
aj: For rollout strategy: create pool with max 2 nodes, run perf smoke on sample job set, then increase to 6 when quota cleared. Keep H100 reserved pool of size 1 with taint `canary=true:NoSchedule` for critical smoke tests.
maria: Plan: (1) create `burst-a10g-preempt` max=2 now, taint=workload=burst:NoSchedule, autoscaler flags per Lucy; (2) create `canary-h100` size=1 reserved, taint=canary=true; (3) update CI pipeline to label batch jobs with tolerations and nodeSelector; (4) coordinate with netops for NAT request; (5) once Q-4321 approved, bump max to 6 and monitor.
devon: I'll create the infra-as-code PR w/ the pool defs and temporary maxNodes=2. Also attach a small dashboard: gpu_util, pod_pending_by_nodepool, preemptions/sec, eviction_rate.
samir: Small nit: set `pod-eviction-timeout` in our runtime config so the batch job controller can checkpoint before preemption. Also ensure KV cache size for batches is sane.
junior: (just joined channel) quick q — how do I test a job will land on the burst pool locally?
samir: Use `kubectl apply -f` with the pod spec above (nodeSelector + toleration). Then `kubectl get pods -o wide` to verify nodeName and labels. Also can force scheduling by adding `tolerationSeconds` if needed.
maria: After deploy, please run this smoke job set: `tests/burst-smoke/run.sh --input=1000 --concurrency=4` and capture tail latency percentiles. Post results here.
aj: One more: cost signal — add a daily job to sample cost-per-token on burst pool vs dedicated. Helps Optimize team recommend quantization or throttling.
infra-bot: reminder: policy requires tagging nodepool with `cost-center` and `env`. Missing in draft PR.
devon: will add tags. I'll link PR once ready: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4567
maria: OK team — thanks. If no objections I'll start the PR and kick off quota ticket follow-ups. :thumbsup:
aj: No objections from me. :rocket:
lucy: Looks good. Monitor autoscaler events closely during first 24h.
samir: I'll prepare toleration helper snippets for our job templates.
maria: Closing loop — I'll post follow-up once PR lands and quota updates arrive. Thanks!
